scope: Builder manual source/API availability review; separate from independent source audit and all rendered/runtime acceptance.
review: Every unguarded API in the new Swift production source is available by iOS 14. No newer API or availability-dependent fallback is used.
reviewed_swiftui_apis: View, ViewBuilder, State, Button, ButtonStyle, Text, Image(systemName:), Rectangle, VStack, HStack, ForEach, Color(.sRGB), Font.title2/body/headline and weight
id, frame, padding, background, fill, fixedSize, lineLimit(nil), multilineTextAlignment, foregroundColor, contentShape, buttonStyle, disabled
accessibilityElement(children:), accessibilityLabel, accessibilityIdentifier, accessibilityHidden, accessibilityAddTraits and isSelected
reviewed_standard_library_apis: Equatable, Identifiable, Array, enumerated, String(Int), Bool.toggle(), UInt32 arithmetic and Double conversion
limitations: The API check emits the actual library module and typechecks the unchanged bridge for arm64-apple-ios14.0-simulator. It does not link, launch or test iOS 14 runtime behavior.
